meta: 5 habits for using AI safely that everyone should have: you don't need to be good with tech, just repeat them every day.

muc.title: Five small habits
muc.text: Using AI safely doesn't require tech skills, just five small habits repeated every day.

muc.title: Hide details, check sources
muc.text: One, delete names, ID numbers and account numbers before pasting. Two, ask for sources and open them before trusting a number.

muc.title: Fence in agents, stop at traps
muc.text: Three, don't let agents pay or send emails on their own. Four, when you see easy-job high-pay offers, strange QR codes or apps asking to read your texts, stop.

muc.title: Experts decide
muc.text: Five, for money, contracts and official papers, AI helps you understand, but a qualified person decides.

muc.title: Score your five habits
muc.text: Score yourself on the five habits and pick one you're missing to start today.
